rules.statement: SCLK edge 1 (lead) must occur D i_clk cycles after command acceptance, where D = PARA_SPI_CLK_DIV.
o_cs_n must go low at the acceptance edge itself (0 cycles after command acceptance) for the first byte of a burst.
o_rsp_valid must become 1 16·D i_clk cycles after command acceptance.

rules.condition: After SCLK edge 16 of last byte
rules.statement: o_cs_n must go high D i_clk cycles after SCLK edge 16 of the last byte (trail).
o_cs_n must stay high for at least D i_clk cycles between bursts.
Byte period inside a continuous burst must be 16·D i_clk cycles.
o_cs_n low time of an n-byte continuous burst must be 16·n·D + D i_clk cycles.
Minimum time between first acceptances of consecutive n-byte bursts must be 16·n·D + 2·D i_clk cycles.
The minimum period of single-byte bursts must be 18·D i_clk cycles.

rules.condition: For a continuous burst without SCLK pause
rules.statement: The next command must be valid in the last cycle of the current transfer.

rules.condition: For a continuous burst without SCLK pause
rules.statement: o_rsp_valid must be 0 in the last cycle of the current transfer, so the previous response must be taken within 16·D − 1 cycles of becoming valid.

rules.condition: o_rsp_valid = 1 in the last cycle of a transfer
rules.statement: The next transfer must not start at SCLK edge 16.

rules.condition: o_rsp_valid = 1 in the last cycle of a transfer
rules.statement: The burst must enter Pause, or Trail if it was the last byte.

rules.condition: Shown byte not yet taken at the end of a running transfer
rules.statement: That transfer's byte must become the held byte.

rules.condition: Until both shown and held bytes have been taken
rules.statement: No new transfer may start until both bytes have been taken.
Responses must come out in command order.

rules.condition: Back-pressure with held byte, when i_rsp_ready goes to 1
rules.statement: Byte N is taken at edge H, byte N+1 is loaded at H with o_rsp_valid staying 1 and taken at H+1, then o_cmd_ready returns to 1 in Pause.

rules.condition: i_rsp_ready stays 0 after byte N is shown at A_N + 16·D
rules.statement: Transfer N+1 starts at that edge; at A_N + 32·D byte N+1 becomes held and the burst enters Pause or Trail because o_cmd_ready was forced 0.
